stances.claim: JFC's global expansion places it among the elite global QSRs (McDonald's, Burger King, Starbucks, Subway) and lifts Tony Tan Caktiong to the league of world-class entrepreneurs like Jack Ma and Jeff Bezos -- a 'Proudly Filipino' achievement.

JFC's stock-price history (P9 in 1993; P325 pre-COVID peak; P100 pandemic low; ~P230 recovery) is a 36x compounding success that, combined with an eight-year plan to enter the top 5 and double stores/sales/net income, establishes long-term confidence.

Tan has remained humble, friendly, generous, and patriotic -- manifest in the Jollibee Group Foundation's FoodAID program (8.4M meals across 358 cities and 60 provinces from 2020 to June 2022) and BLT Kitchens (240,000 pupils fed since 2007 with 400+ parent volunteers).

Tan's acceptance speech captures the legacy ethic the column endorses: 'we never intended to become big just for the sake of becoming big' -- the goal was a vision 'we, our people, and our country can all be proud of.'

one_paragraph_summary: Panganiban opens the New Year with a celebratory profile of Jollibee Foods Corporation (JFC) and its founder, chair, and self-styled 'chief taste officer' Dr. Tony Tan Caktiong. The recent inaugurations at Times Square in New York and in iconic places in London, Milan, Vancouver, Dubai, Singapore, and across Asia complete JFC's ascent to international QSR status alongside McDonald's, Burger King, Starbucks, and Subway, and place Tan among 'world-class entrepreneurs in the likes of Jack Ma of China and Jeff Bezos of the United States.' From a 1978 mom-and-pop store with wife Grace and the now-celebrated Chickenjoy, JFC has grown to over 6,300 stores with 17 brands sold in 33 countries (Mang Inasal, Chowking, Red Ribbon, Greenwich Pizza, Michelin-starred Tim Ho Wan, China's Yonghe King, America's Smashburger, the world's Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf). Listed in 1993 at P9, JFC peaked at P325 pre-COVID (36x in under 30 years), fell to P100 in the pandemic, and recovered to about P230 -- and aims in eight years to be among the top five global QSRs while doubling store count, sales, and net income. Beyond business, Tan chaired the private-sector counterpart of Apec 2015 in Manila (Nov. 18-19, attended by Obama, Xi Jinping, Medvedev, and Trudeau), and the Jollibee Group Foundation (JGF) -- under his chair-emeritus role -- runs the farmer-supplier program, the FoodAID program (8.4 million meals served from 2020 to June 2022 across 358 cities and 60 provinces), and Busog, Lusog, Talino (BLT) Kitchens (240,000 pupils fed since 2007 with 400+ parent volunteers trained). The Phinma-AIM-Manila Jaycees RVR Award for Nation Building recently named him sole awardee; in his acceptance speech he traced JFC's three visions (No. 1 in the PH → No. 1 in Asia → top 5 in the world), insisting 'we never intended to become big just for the sake of becoming big.' Panganiban -- who chairs the RVR board of judges with Ramon R. Del Rosario Jr., Manuel V. Pangilinan, Jesus P. Tambunting, Jose L. Cuisia Jr., Jikyeong Kang, Oscar Hilado, and Richard Lim -- discloses at the foot of the column that he has been a nonexecutive director of JFC and a member of its executive committee since 2010.
